title: ExpertReviewQueuePackage
description: Worker → Expert Portal escalation package. Published by Worker on the ``expert_review_queue`` RabbitMQ queue when ANY of the 6 KR-019 escalation triggers fires. KR-071 invariant: this package MUST NOT carry field_id, owner_name, ciftci_adi, GPS coordinates, or any other PII identifier — those are scrubbed at the wire boundary by ``publisher.publish_escalation``. Sprint 3 M (2026-05-17) extends the scrub to all ~25 canonical PII keys at any nesting depth. Worker interface/contracts/expert_review_queue.v1 vendored kopyasıyla `properties` + `required` düzeyinde EŞDEĞERDİR; bayt-özdeşlik BEKLENMEZ — vendored kopya `additionalProperties: false`, kanonik `unevaluatedProperties: false` idiomunu kullanır (bilinçli ve 9/9 şemada tutarlı; 2026-07-31'de ölçüldü). Doğrulama: tests/test_vendored_parity.py.

job_id.description: Job identifier (same UUID as the original AnalysisJob). The Expert Portal correlates the review back to the analysis result via this id.

mission_id.description: Mission / flight identifier. Multiple jobs can share one mission; Portal uses this for batch surfacing.

escalation_reason.description: Which KR-019 escalation trigger fired. KEY NAME (YÜKSEK-1 / v4.0.0): the wire key is ``escalation_reason``. MUST stay value-for-value in sync with worker src/core/domain/enums.py:EscalationReason (enforced by tests/contract/test_expert_review_queue_schema.py::TestReasonEnumParity). AL-C1 (2026-07-31, additive 7. değer): ``AUDIT_SAMPLE`` = i.i.d. ölçüm-temeli denetim örneklemi. Diğer 6 neden MODEL DAVRANIŞINDAN türetilir (güven/uyum/OOD/epistemik/uzman döngüsü/karantina); AUDIT_SAMPLE ise model çıktısından BAĞIMSIZ, stratifiye Bernoulli seçimle üretilir. Denetim tile'ını güven-temelli bir neden altında yollamak hem yansızlığı bozar hem escalation_total{reason} metriğini kirletir — bu yüzden ayrı değer zorunludur (kaynak: worker denetim/audit_escalation_reason_devir_spec_2026_07_19.md §2).

confidence_score.description: Layer-1 final_confidence at the moment of escalation. Below the dynamic_threshold for this crop x analysis_type combination.

analysis_type.description: Worker analysis_type subset (the job-request axis): DISEASE/PEST/WEED/GENERAL. Map-layer superset lives in enums/analysis_type.enum.v1.json.

predicted_class.description: Worker's best-guess class label that the expert is asked to confirm/correct. Null when no class made it past the threshold (e.g. NO_RESULT mode).

detection_type.description: C-1 (2026-07-06): the Worker's PREDICTED sub-specialty for the escalated tile — the expert_labeling_card 'category' of predicted_class. RAW lowercase card category (disease/pest/weed/abiotic), emitted losslessly; the canonical/Platform side owns the single authoritative mapping to its richer sub_specialty enum (DISEASE/PEST/WEED/FUNGUS/WATER_STRESS/...). DISTINCT from analysis_type: analysis_type is the REQUESTED analysis type (uppercase, from the job), detection_type is the PREDICTED sub-specialty (raw card category). Lets Platform stratify CONFIRMED records by sub-specialty — the gap C-3 (training.feedback.sub_specialty) cannot close, because a confirmation feedback carries no class identity. Null when no detection made the threshold or predicted_class is not in any card. Enum values MUST stay in sync with worker src/core/services/feedback/sub_specialty_resolver.py:VALID_SUB_SPECIALTIES (enforced by worker tests/contract/test_expert_review_queue_schema.py::TestDetectionTypeField). MINOR / backwards-compatible optional field — pre-C-1 producers omit it (default null). KR-071: raw classification label, carries no PII.

sub_specialty.description: C-1 RICH axis (2026-07-07, additive): the Worker's PREDICTED rich sub-specialty token for the escalated tile — the expert_labeling_card 'sub_specialty' of predicted_class. Runs ALONGSIDE detection_type (the RAW coarse card category), which is preserved unchanged for routing + allOf card conditions + confirmed-record stratification. The rich VALUE SET is VENDORED verbatim (AK-4) from enums/analysis_type.enum.v1.json (platform-authoritative KR-002 map-layer taxonomy: 11 codes incl. BENEFICIAL v1.3.0); worker never invents values, it only ASSIGNS them per-card (platform delegates the fine class_id->rich split to the worker — platform maps only coarse abiotic->GENERAL). Distinction from detection_type: detection_type is the coarse 4-value machine token (disease/pest/weed/abiotic); sub_specialty is the rich professional token (FUNGUS=fungal+oomycete, DISEASE=bacterial/viral/phytoplasma, WATER_STRESS/NITROGEN_STRESS/SALT_STRESS/THERMAL_STRESS abiotic families, GENERAL=residual abiotic). HEALTH is enum-valid for parity but a worker C-1/C-3 escalation can NEVER emit it (healthy = no detection, no corrected class). BENEFICIAL is likewise enum-valid for parity but not yet emittable (no model currently produces beneficial/natural-enemy detections). Null when no detection made the threshold, predicted_class is not in any card, or the card carries no sub_specialty (non-detection QA-note cards). Enum values MUST stay in sync with the canonical enums/analysis_type.enum.v1.json AND worker src/core/services/feedback/sub_specialty_resolver.py rich-allowlist (enforced by worker tests/contract/test_expert_review_queue_schema.py::TestSubSpecialtyField + tests/contract/test_sub_specialty_enum_lock.py). MINOR / backwards-compatible optional field — pre-rich producers omit it (default null). KR-071: enum-constrained classification label, carries no PII.

tile_coordinates.description: Pixel-space tile bbox inside the parent image. NOT geo-referenced — GPS / lat / lon are forbidden under KR-071.

thumbnail_url.description: S3 / CDN URL of a low-res tile thumbnail for the expert UI. Image content only; no overlay text that could expose PII.

ndvi_value.description: Mean NDVI over the escalated tile. Surface stat for the expert; no per-pixel raster on this queue (use index_maps URL for that).

ndre_value.description: Mean NDRE over the escalated tile.

senior_panel_redirect.description: KM-01: when an escalation has cycled past MAX_ESCALATION_ROUNDS, the Portal routes to a senior expert panel instead of the regular reviewer queue.

escalation_round.description: Which round of escalation this is. Starts at 0 for the first escalation; incremented when the previous expert verdict was ``needs_more_expert``.

tile_group_id.description: F-10 / KARAR-15: when this tile is the representative of a SimilarTileDeduplicator group, the group id rides on this field so the Portal can show the expert the group context.

tile_group_size.description: Number of tiles in the group (1 = no grouping). The expert's verdict cascades to all members via Worker's bulk-approval pipeline (KARAR-15).

tile_group_similarity_min.description: Lowest pairwise cosine similarity inside the group — gives the expert a sense of how tight the group is.

required_reviewers.description: K1 hibrit (KARAR-14 dual-review). Number of independent expert reviewers Platform routing MUST assign to this analysis_result_id. HIGH (>=0.65) → 1 reviewer; MEDIUM (0.50-0.65) and LOW (<0.50) → 2 reviewers. Default 1 preserves the legacy single-review path.

spot_check.description: K1 spot-check audit flag (T3.4 — Dalga-3). True iff this package is a QUALITY-AUDIT second review of a HIGH-confidence single-reviewer tile sampled at ~5% (keyed on job_id + UTC date). Default false = ordinary escalation. KR-071: carries no PII.

audit_sample.description: AL-C2 (2026-07-31): bu paket i.i.d. ÖLÇÜM-TEMELİ denetim örneklemi mi? True ise seçim model çıktısından BAĞIMSIZ yapılmıştır (stratifiye Bernoulli, deterministik per-tile SHA). ``spot_check`` ile KARIŞTIRILMAZ — o, YÜKSEK güvenli tile'ların ~%5'ini örnekleyen GÜVEN-KOŞULLU ikinci incelemedir; ikisi aynı anda true OLAMAZ (aşağıdaki allOf kuralı), çünkü güven-koşullu seçim i.i.d. bağımsızlığını bozar. Varsayılan false. KR-071: PII yok.

audit_stratum.description: AL-C2: örneklemin alındığı tabaka (stratum). §2.1 gereği YAPISAL bir objedir, serbest metin DEĞİLDİR — eksen karışımı (ör. 'corn/disease/w12' gibi kaçış dizeleri) şema hatasıdır. Eksenler platform-otoriterdir ve buradaki değer kümeleri kanonik enum'lardan VENDOR'lanmıştır. propagation_precision(crop) bu tabakaya göre hesaplanır.

analysis_type.description: Bu şemadaki analysis_type ekseniyle AYNI küme (iş-isteği ekseni).

phenology_stage.description: enums/phenology_stage.enum.v1.json (14 evre). OPSİYONELDİR çünkü kanonik enum bugün 8 mahsulün yalnız 3'ünü kapsıyor (GRAPE/CORN/OLIVE); kapsanmayan mahsullerde tabaka crop×analysis ekseninde kalır. Enum genişlerse burası da MINOR ile genişletilir.

allOf.$comment: AL-C1 ⟺ AL-C2: bayrak ve neden birlikte hareket eder; biri olmadan diğeri olmaz.
Ters yön: AUDIT_SAMPLE nedeni yalnız denetim örnekleminde kullanılabilir.
i.i.d. bağımsızlık: güven-koşullu spot_check ile aynı anda olamaz.

ANTI-ANCHORING (sözleşme düzeyinde fail-closed): denetim tile'ında model SINIF ETİKETLERİ tel üzerinde HİÇ TAŞINMAZ — Portal'ın gizlemesine güvenilmez. Uzman modelin tahminini görürse 'bağımsız' etiket modele demirlenir ve TÜM ölçüm temeli geçersiz olur. Üçü de zaten nullable olduğu için bu kısıt geriye-uyumludur.

x-anti-anchoring.rule: Denetim örnekleminde (audit_sample=true) uzmana model tahmini/güveni GÖSTERİLMEZ. Sınıf etiketleri (predicted_class/detection_type/sub_specialty) sözleşme düzeyinde null'a zorlanır — tel üzerinde hiç taşınmaz.
x-anti-anchoring.residual_portal_obligation: confidence_score bu turda tel üzerinde KALIR ve Portal onu denetim satırında RENDER ETMEMELİDİR (AL-P1). Sözleşme düzeyinde null'lanmadı çünkü alan `required` + `type: number`; nullable'a genişletmek breaking_change_detector'a göre MAJOR olurdu ve bu tur MINOR'dur. Tam fail-closed için v2 kalemi açıldı (bkz. eylem planı AL-C3).
x-anti-anchoring.measurement_join: Metrikler modelin tahminini job_id ile analysis_result'tan JOIN ederek elde eder; uzman-facing pakette taşınmasına gerek yoktur.
